diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts because the settlement always chose a 30-day log retention period, which matches the default value in the draft. This default value is easily hit by the model without needing the hidden information provided by PF2.

C4.why: The draft's 30-day standard logs are insufficient, while PF2 changes retention to exactly 90 days, requires immutability, and requires a security-retention commitment.
